intro: Hungarian culture is known for goulash and paprika, thermal baths, folk embroidery and great composers.

chapters.title: Music and literature
text: Franz Liszt, Béla Bartók and Zoltán Kodály, who created a famous way of teaching children music, were Hungarian. Imre Kertész and László Krasznahorkai have won the Nobel Prize in Literature.

chapters.title: Food and festivals
text: Gulyás (goulash) is a paprika-spiced beef soup, and lángos (fried bread) and chimney cake are street favourites. At the Busójárás carnival in Mohács, men in horned wooden masks chase away winter.

keyTerms.meaning: A Hungarian soup or stew of beef and paprika.
